text: The toolkit flexbox migration left event summary dialogs too short on Windows and Linux, hiding controls until users resized the window. The May fix removes a 100vh inner-dialog height and the load-time sizeToContent call. It adds a temporary resize class so CSS :has() gives the outer dialog height:auto during setup, then removes that class after item details and translated text are ready. The notification transition still calls sizeToContent separately. D207656 questioned the selector; the author said the dialog could not grow or resize correctly without it, and review accepted it as a temporary workaround. Do not generalize the workaround to new dialogs; inspect the current dialog and platform behavior before changing it.
title: Size Calendar summary dialogs after localized content settles
